description: A Schedule C net loss reduces earned income for the § 21(d)(1) limit (Pub. 503: 'You must reduce your earned income by any net loss from self-employment'). HoH 2025: wages $20,000, Schedule C loss $30,000, interest $100,000, $3,000 of care expenses for one child. Earned income $20,000 − $30,000 → $0, so no expenses are creditable and the credit is $0 (wages alone gave $600).
